accounting.rationale: Fine subdivision of ASSOCIATE association purpose.
Fine subdivision identifying named construct entities.

requirements.title: ASSOCIATE associates named construct entities with expressions or variables during block execution
requirements.definition: The ASSOCIATE construct associates named entities with expressions or variables during execution of its block. The named construct entities are associating entities and their names are associate names. Detailed selector evaluation, type, attribute, definability, and scope effects are owned by 11.1.3.2 and 11.1.3.3 plus Clause 19 dependencies.
requirements.oracle:
This paragraph defines the construct purpose and terminology. It does not by itself create diagnostics for bad selector syntax or name mismatch; those are R/C units below.

Each claimed facet has a distinct assertion and a feature-level mutation recorded in the generator; numbered constraint negatives have one-property conforming controls and line-anchored diagnostics.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future ASSOCIATE fixtures must use non-vacuous selectors and sentinels: lower bounds must differ where bounds are asserted, character length must be checked with LEN rather than inferred from padded comparison, outer homonyms must start with values different from any inner assignment, and assignment through an associate name is credited only after the selector is established definable. No plan may count selector evaluations, depend on function side effects, assume a real or complex kind exists, or use compiler agreement as an oracle.

requirements.title: Nonvariable or vector-subscript selectors make associate names nondefinable and unavailable for pointer association
requirements.definition: If a selector is not a variable, or is a variable with a vector subscript, neither the associate name nor any subobject of it shall appear in a variable definition context or pointer association context.

requirements.title: The expression selector alternative is not a variable
requirements.definition: The expr alternative of selector shall not be a variable. A variable selector is represented by the variable alternative instead, so this constraint is treated as source classification rather than a standalone negative for ordinary x => y source.
requirements.oracle:
Do not create a negative from an ordinary variable selector, because that source is conforming through R1105 variable.
